rationale: Runs are the durable planning unit that groups a deployment and its deterministic shards and trials. They are required to express the complete initial work graph and use established domain vocabulary.
alternatives: Flatten shards into CampaignPlan only if deployments can never differ; the current nested structure supports multiple planned deployments without a generic bag.
Rename to executions would blur logical planned work with physical controller Job attempts.
simplestChoice: Keep `runs` as the required array of logical run plans.
